name: bld5_commuting_idempotents_rank_sub_iff
statement: (K : Type*) [Field K] [CharZero K] (ι : Type*) [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] (A B : Matrix ι ι K) (hA : A * A = A) (hB : B * B = B) (hAB : A * B = B * A) : (A - B).rank + B.rank = A.rank ↔ A * B = B
closed: ∀ (K : Type*) [Field K] [CharZero K] (ι : Type*) [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] (A B : Matrix ι ι K) (hA : A * A = A) (hB : B * B = B) (hAB : A * B = B * A), (A - B).rank + B.rank = A.rank ↔ A * B = B
informal: Uses Mathlib2.bld3_commuting_idempotents_rank_sub, Mathlib2.bld_idempotent_sum_rank and Mathlib2.lib_matrix_rank_eq_zero_iff: bld3 gives rank(A−B) + 2·rank(AB) = rank A + rank B, so the left side is equivalent to rank(AB) = rank B. AB and B − AB are idempotents (commutativity) with idempotent sum B, so bld_idempotent_sum_rank gives rank B = rank(AB) + rank(B − AB). Hence rank(AB) = rank B ↔ rank(B − AB) = 0 ↔ B − AB = 0 by lib_matrix_rank_eq_zero_iff.
type: ∀ (K : Type u_1) [inst : Field K] [CharZero K] (ι : Type u_2) [inst_2 : Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] (A B : Matrix ι ι K), A * A = A → B * B = B → A * B = B * A → ((A - B).rank + B.rank = A.rank ↔ A * B = B)
